source_comparison.rule: DoExecObjTrigger only delivers SPAWN_BOT on damage; pickup/removal is not a damage event. DoSpawnBots calls BossSpewRobot, whose CreateGatedRobot requires an existing boss record before creating a robot. The observed non-autoplay powerup action cannot spawn.

criterion: same byte-identical archive, three advertised ordinals and unassisted inputs; level loads and executes 120 simulation frames at 60 Hz

baseline.affected_first_blocker: object triggers at record 0: spawn-bot action requires a robot boss owner

controls: The other two advertised entries remained loaded_ticked/120 frames. xl_inventory_contract and xl_effect_payloads passed; the contract retains rejection of autoplay powerup spawns and other nonrobot owners.
scope: Only damage-only non-autoplay SPAWN_BOT actions owned by powerups bypass the boss-owner and spawn-resource requirement. The original action remains in the runtime table and is consumed on pickup. This establishes startup, not all authored interactions or a completed Anthology flight.
